verdict.rationale: Long-term memory is a fair axis for an agent framework, but the evidence pack never documents a memory service or any mechanism that persists agent memory across sessions and threads. The nearby items cover something else: context management that summarizes older turns in a conversation, workflow state management, and Artifacts as persistent file or document outputs. None of these is cross-session long-term memory, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can give agents long-term memory that persists across sessions and threads
